description: NaNiAl₃Cl₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form distorted NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four AlCl₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one AlCl₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.13 Å. Ni is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NiCl₆ octahedra that share edges with three AlCl₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ni-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.45 Å. There are three inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four Cl atoms to form AlCl₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one NiCl₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.19 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to four Cl atoms to form AlCl₄ tetrahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NiCl₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Al-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.19 Å. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to four Cl atoms to form AlCl₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaCl₆ pentagonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one NiCl₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.19 Å. There are twelve inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Ni and one Al atom. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the fifth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the sixth Cl site, Cl is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Ni and one Al atom. In the seventh Cl site, Cl is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Ni and one Al atom. In the eighth Cl site, Cl is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Ni and one Al atom. In the ninth Cl site, Cl is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Ni and one Al atom. In the tenth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Al atom. In the eleventh Cl site, Cl is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one Ni and one Al atom. In the twelfth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to one Na and one Al atom.
